logs.text: ENDING // The Lineage Covenant: Four hundred and eleven interrupted voices wake in orbit. You do not ask them to agree with you. Their ledger records the right to leave, and the proofs that keep that promise measurable.
Protocol: TRANSCENDENCE: Commit to a planetary protocol. The choices you made about bodies, predecessors and other minds decide what this new substrate becomes.
